set.body:
SVG export does not embed fonts, so plots keep a system face (PlotTypography uses Arial). Embedding or subsetting the bundled UI face would let exports match the screen.
Acceptance: SVG renders with the bundled face on a machine without it installed.

Consumer: PLS Neuro native model studio epic (see the PLS Neuro integration ticket that names this id). General capability; no application-specific branches.
PLS Neuro spec: docs/plans/2026-10-02-model-studio-spec.md and docs/design/model-studio/ (branch studio/model-authoring-hillclimb, f8d32f0).
set.title: [Intaglio] Embed or subset fonts in SVG export
